summary.claim_boundary: Local CASP17 organic ligand metric batch operator-fill kit only. It consolidates the existing organic ligand operator-fill worklist into one batch intake CSV plus candidate packets. It does not mutate evidence templates, fill values, approve no-leak provenance, compute LDDT-PLI or BiSyRMSD, mark competitive proof, serialize a CASP author code, or submit to CASP.
